intro: Reconstruct the narrative puzzle through time clues, infer the characters' motives and analyse the everyday misunderstandings of community life.

palabras.significado: to repay a debt of gratitude
palabras.consejo: Pronominal verb of courtesy and reciprocity.

frases.estudio: Il pacco arrivò tre giorni dopo la data prevista quando Matteo era già partito.
frases.alumno: The parcel arrived three days after the expected date, when Matteo had already left.

frases.estudio: La vicina custodì la scatola nel suo appartamento dopo aver firmato la ricevuta.
frases.alumno: The neighbour looked after the box in her flat after having signed for it.

frases.estudio: Sapendo dell'importanza della spedizione, decise di conservare i farmaci al fresco.
frases.alumno: Aware of how important the shipment was, she decided to keep the medicines somewhere cool.

frases.estudio: Matteo tornò la mattina seguente e ringraziò la signora con un omaggio gradito.
frases.alumno: Matteo came back the next morning and thanked the lady with a welcome gift.

texto: Il pacco arrivò tre giorni dopo la data prevista dal corriere, quando Matteo era già partito per lavoro alla volta di Torino. La vicina del piano di sopra, che di solito ritirava la posta per tutto il condominio con proverbiale zelo, decise di custodire la scatola nel suo ingresso dopo aver firmato la ricevuta telematica. Non sapeva, però, che Matteo aspettava da settimane una confezione di campioni farmaceutici refrigerati per la sua farmacia. La sera stessa, allarmato dal ritardo e da una notifica automatica dell'applicazione mobile, il farmacista telefonò alla vicina; lei lo rassicurò spiegando di aver riposto la scatola al fresco nella cantina condominiale, intuendone l'importanza dall'etichetta speciale. Il giorno dopo, rientrando in città con il primo treno, Matteo trovò tutto intatto e le portò una scatola di cioccolatini per sdebitarsi della premurosa gentilezza.

pregunta.texto: Why was Matteo unable to collect the parcel himself when the courier arrived?

opciones.texto: He was already on a work trip to Turin.
opciones.explicacion: The story makes clear that «era già partito per lavoro alla volta di Torino».

opciones.texto: He had lost the key to the post box at the main entrance.
opciones.explicacion: There was no key problem; he was simply away from the city.

opciones.texto: He refused to pay the customs charges on the parcel.
opciones.explicacion: No unpaid customs duty is mentioned.

frase.texto: La vicina custodì la scatola dopo ___ firmato la ricevuta del corriere.

opciones.explicacion: Compound infinitive structure «dopo aver + past participle».
A redundant form that changes the syntax of the time construction.
Wrong auxiliary for the transitive verb «firmare».

pregunta.texto: What sensible step did the neighbour take when she noticed the box's special label?

opciones.texto: She put the box in the shared cellar to keep the contents refrigerated.
opciones.explicacion: She worked out from the warning label that it needed to be kept cool.

opciones.texto: She opened the original packaging to check the state of the medicine bottles.
opciones.explicacion: She never handled the contents of Matteo's box.

opciones.texto: She forwarded the parcel to the central pharmacy by another express courier.
opciones.explicacion: She kept the parcel in her care until the neighbour came back.

pregunta.texto: How did Matteo show his gratitude to the neighbour when he came back?

opciones.texto: By giving her a box of chocolates to thank her for her kind help.
opciones.explicacion: «Le portò una scatola di cioccolatini per sdebitarsi».

opciones.texto: By rewarding her with a cash payment.
opciones.explicacion: The neighbourly kindness was repaid with a warm gesture, not with money.

opciones.texto: By offering her a job as an assistant in his pharmacy.
opciones.explicacion: An invention with no basis in the text.

piezas.explicacion: Put the final sentence of the story in order.

pregunta.texto: What time relationship does «dopo aver riposto» express in the neighbour's words?

opciones.texto: That putting it safely in the cellar happened before the phone call.
opciones.explicacion: Compound infinitive of a completed earlier action.

opciones.texto: That she will move the box to the cellar the next day if it gets hotter.
opciones.explicacion: It confuses a completed event with a future promise.

opciones.texto: That she never got round to moving the parcel from her front door.
opciones.explicacion: It contradicts the account of the conversation between them.
